sentences.text: Sialidosis type 1 and sialidosis type 2 are both recorded as caused by the gene NEU1 [e_b9fc423c9631] [e_b468f95d5f04].
Both gene links are curated, meaning they come from Orphanet and OMIM [e_b9fc423c9631] [e_b468f95d5f04].
Constellate computed that the two types have fairly similar symptom profiles, with a score of 0.400 over 25 shared terms [e_2dd23c2da071].
That similarity is inferred, meaning Constellate calculated it, and it is not a database finding [e_2dd23c2da071].
For type 2, an observed feature is reduced neuraminidase activity in tissue, from one report, and kidney disease is curated as very frequent [e_d9fd43198d07] [e_28481e145467].
Type 1 is linked to a research grant in NIH RePORTER about glycoprotein disorders [e_22b1bede460d].
These edges do not show how the two types differ, and they list no symptoms for type 1, no studies and no treatments [e_2dd23c2da071] [e_b9fc423c9631].
